summary: Saint Thomas Aquinas was a Dominican theologian whose writings explain the harmony of faith and reason. He is honored as a teacher of the Church and a guide in prayerful study.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Thomas Aquinas as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Thomas Aquinas, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
